empirical_TAPS.limitation: The released TAPS channels are already resampled and globally aligned; they cannot alone validate independent unsynchronized acquisition clocks.

interpretation_limits: Synthetic performance is not empirical sensor evidence.
Inferred event correspondences are not ground-truth state identities.
The alignment confidence score is not a calibrated probability.
The matcher assumes monotone event order and sufficiently informative shared event marks/interval structure.
Post-match affine clock fitting is diagnostic rather than a synchronization operation.
